name: Carp
description: The carp is one of the most famous freshwater fish and has been bred as a food fish for centuries. It is robust, long-lived and can reach impressive sizes.
habitat: Carp prefer warm, standing or slowly flowing waters with muddy bottoms and rich plant growth. They are found in ponds, lakes and river backwaters.
diet: Bottom feeder - feeds on worms, insect larvae, snails, mussels and plant material at the bottom of the water
features: Four barbels on the upper jaw
Long dorsal fin with serrated hard ray
conservation: Not endangered - widespread through stocking, wild forms partly endangered
funFact: Carp are incredibly intelligent and trainable! They can be trained to respond to bells to be fed. Some carp even recognize individual people and can distinguish faces. In Japan there are koi carp that have lived over 200 years!
